items.title: John Lamb interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 16, 2001
items.q: after that little experience I got a job playing in another club, in Eddie Levine’s place on the corner of Mass and Columbus in Boston.

ctx.x: Did you decide not to go there because you just couldn’t afford it?

Well I couldn’t go there, no money. But while I was getting my money back, I heard this beautiful bass sound coming out of the room. Somebody was bowing this instrument. I said oh that’s so beautiful, I didn’t realize that a bass could sound like that. And all of this sound was filtering out. I don’t have any idea to this day who that was. But it stayed with me. And while washing these dishes, these pots, there was a group out in the lobby playing. And I looked out there and the guys all had tuxes you know,…
